card.name: Letter-spaced all-caps headings
card.fires_on: Single capital letters inside headings spelled out with spaces, such as D O S A G E A N D A D M I N I S T R A T I O N. It also fires on some words in all-caps warning text.

modes.label: Spaced-out heading letters
modes.description: Individual capital letters within a letter-spaced section title, mostly DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION.
modes.example: D O S A G E A N D A<< D>> M INI S T R A T

modes.label: All-caps warning sentences
modes.description: Linking words in all-caps boxed warning text, like SHOULD or WHICH.
modes.example: ACTIONS WHEN TREATED WITH CEPHALOSPORINS. BEFORE THERAPY WITH ANY PENICILLIN, CAREFUL INQUIRY<< SHOULD>> BE MADE CONCERNING PREVIOUS

card.writes: It pushes the next output toward lowercase single letters and away from capital letters, which fits continuing a spaced-out word.
card.plain: It spots headings printed with spaced capital letters, where the model must keep spelling the word letter by letter.
